name: planner-web-spectral-main-sync
objective: Publish the verified spectral visualization and fluorophore picker wave on a feature branch synchronized with Claude's newly merged main, without rebasing or altering main.
invariants: origin/main is fetched and treated as the integration source; no rebase or force push is used.
The verified spectral/picker wave is committed with the required Codex agent trailer before integration.
Claude's merged LLM/question/advisor changes and Codex's panel/spectral changes both survive the merge.
The combined tree passes the full web suite, build tests, deterministic double build, and an independent frontier review before push.
Only codex/fluorophore-expansion is pushed; main is not modified by this run.

tasks.title: Fetch and audit Claude's merged main
tasks.scope: Fetch origin, verify the published main/feature refs, inspect c4d4289..origin/main and identify overlap/couplings with the local spectral/picker wave.
tasks.verification: Record exact refs and changed-file overlap; confirm the target contains Claude's question/advisor/chat-LLM changes and the prior Codex expansion.

tasks.title: Commit the verified local wave
tasks.scope: Commit the complete already-verified spectral visualization, filter interaction, fluorophore picker, tests, plans, and handover with the required Agent trailer.
tasks.verification: Commit contains only the declared Codex wave, has Agent: Codex/gpt-5.6-sol-medium, and leaves no unstaged wave files.

tasks.title: Merge origin/main into the feature branch
tasks.scope: Merge origin/main into codex/fluorophore-expansion without rebase. Resolve only mechanical overlap while preserving both lanes; regenerate the dashboard snapshot through update.py if required.
tasks.verification: origin/main is an ancestor of HEAD; both Claude and Codex representative symbols/data are present; no unresolved conflicts.

tasks.title: Verify and push the synchronized branch
tasks.scope: Run combined full tests, build gates, deterministic double build, preview freshness, independent frontier review, then push the feature branch normally.
tasks.verification: All gates pass, verifier returns PASS, push succeeds without force, and local HEAD equals origin/codex/fluorophore-expansion.
